contexts.text: Male and female () = the marriage between faith and love. AC 476.
A female = the will, or the things of the will; thus which are of love... and therefore a female = the Church.
(Aged ones of the female sex in Heaven.)
The female sex is such, and so formed, that will or cupidity reigns more than understanding; such is all the disposition of their fibres; such is their nature.
Male = truth; female, good. AC 725. AC 749. AE 294:15. AE 725:2. AE 725:3.
Women, who from a low condition have become rich...
Malignant women from the province of the bladder.
Thou art a woman beautiful in look () = that truth from a celestial origin is delightful.
Under Egypt, see this reference.
Woman = truth; here, () the truth which is in knowledges, with the delights of which the Lord was captivated in His childhood.
The stinking sphere of a certain female...
Eight Societies of the female sex...
Societies of Angels which have the care of little children, and which are chiefly of the female sex... HH 332.
Like (attractive) women who are inwardly diseased. AC 4802:end.
Give me my women () = that the affections of truth were his. Women, or women = affections of truth. AC 4270. AC 4357.
Spirits of the exterior plate of the dura mater... were heard by me as of the female sex. Described.
Women = affections of truth, of Knowledges, and of knowledges.
The way of women () = uncleanness.
Women = affections of truth which is not genuine; thus affections which are not of the Church...
They said that they could conceive many designs from the women, because they are quicker and more skilful in seeing such things... SE 1821.

Their women () = charity. (For) women, women, and wives = affections of truth and affections of good; affections of truth when their married partner is mentioned, and he is called husband; affections of good when their married partner is not mentioned, and when a man is mentioned. References.
They who constitute the province of the internal nostrils are of the female sex; their perspicacity of perception...
Many, chiefly women, who have made everything to consist in things becoming. Described. SE 1226.
(A woman of the planet Mercury.) Described.

They who are in the affection of truth and good, and who... are maid servants, or women, are not affected with knowledge, but with truths and goods themselves when they hear and perceive them with others: such an affection is general with good women... Hence it is that those who are in spiritual perception love women who are affected with truths, but do not love women who are in knowledges; for it is according to Divine order that men should be in knowledges, but women only in affections; and thus that they should not love themselves from knowledges, but men, whence comes the marriage principle. This is why the ancients said that women should be silent in the Church; and on this account scientifics and cognitions are represented by men, and affections by women... This is the case in the Spiritual Kingdom; but... with those who are in the Celestial Kingdom the husbands are in affection, and the wives in the Knowledges of good and truth; and hence is the marriage principle with them.
(Women of various Earths.) Described. AC 9792. AC 10163. AC 10754. SE 3262.
(Old women renewing their youth and beauty in Heaven.)
Hence some can think and speak well, but cannot write well; this is common with the female sex.
Women there. CL 44. SE 4250.
Perhaps you have seen some women.
See Man. CL 50. CL 55:6. CL 197.
Can love stop at the face of a woman?.

The love of a woman for a woman is like the love of an affection of the understanding of men for another such affection; for a woman was created and born to become a love of the understanding of man... Hence two women by their concupiscences sometimes combat like two prize-fighters.
They do not admit the influx of love from the body of any other woman.
As the beauty of a woman, from an implanted inclination, at the same time enters into the mind...
What has wisdom to do with a woman? Explained.
The cause of beauty in the female sex. Fully Explained. See Beauty. CL 381:end.
The good of truth... is in the woman, and is the feminine principle itself.

The woman is born to be voluntary from the Intellectual of the man; or, what is the same, to be the love of the man's wisdom; because she was formed through his wisdom. (This fully shown from the woman's affection, application, manners, and form.)

As the female was created through the truth of the male, and is formed into its love more and more after marriage, it follows that she also receives the truth of the husband into herself, and conjoins it with her own good.
Women are born loves... and men are receptions. CL 161. (Shown by experiment.)
Women are not in this light, which is the reason women do not speak from that wisdom... but only listen.

The feminine principle consists in perceiving from love... and love reaches no further than to what it feels: when it reaches further, it is in consequence of conjunction with the understanding of the man...
Nor is the moral wisdom of the man possible with women, so far as it partakes of his rational wisdom.
Affection does not separate itself from the thoughts with women, as it does with men.
That... with women there is an elevation of the mind into superior heat; and the woman feels the deliciousnesses of her heat in the man's light. Explained. CL 189.

By the heat into which women are elevated, is meant marriage love; because spiritual heat... in its essence is love, and with women it is love conjoining itself with the intelligence and wisdom in men...
The elevation into higher heat with women is elevation into a marriage love more chaste and pure, and constantly to the marriage principle, which from creation is hidden in their inmost principles.
Into like regions is the mind elevated as it is opened; with men by wisdom, and with women by love truly conjugial.
Under Wife, see this reference.
(Thus) the woman was created out of the man by a transcription of his own proper wisdom, which is to be created from natural truth; and the love thereof was transferred from the man into the woman...
The woman's being created while the man slept. (Explained.)
We are not females, but wives... The men said, If you are not females, you are women. They replied, In the first states of marriage we were women; but now we are wives.
(The intelligence of women contrasted with that of men.) General article.
How from their very birth the genius of men diners from that of women...
(Thus) the man is born understanding, and the woman love...
What would be the quality of man's understanding without conjunction with feminine love...
How is the feminine principle propagated from a man's soul?
That the marriage sphere is received by the female sex, and through it is transferred into the male sex. CL 393.
Marriage love exists solely with the female sex...
The female form is the voluntary form...
It is from the transfer of this sphere from the female sex into the male sex that the mind is inflamed from mere thought about the sex...
The similitude of the internal affections is not seen in the woman; for by a native gift she withdraws them into the secret recesses of her mind.
Implanted by artful women before marriage.
The woman acts from the will, and the will can persist.

The reason choice does not belong to the woman, is that she is born to be love; and also because... with women there is the love of one of the sex... Nevertheless, women have the right of choosing one of their suitors... Women are born for love, and therefore do not possess the clearsightedness of this light; consequently, their determinations to marriage would exist merely from the inclinations of their love. If they know how to discriminate between one man and another, still their love is carried away to appearances.
Almost all women... will reject polygamical marriages; from which it follows that women have the love of one of the sex, thus marriage love.
That a woman ought to consult her parents, or those who are in the place of parents, and then deliberate with herself, before she consents.
Under Widow, see this reference.
Under Beauty, see this reference. CL 330:3. CL 330:4.
We women are born into the love of the intelligence of men...
That the sphere of the love of little children chiefly affects the female sex... and the male sex from them.
Upon the marriage love into which women are born is inscribed the love of little children...
In every woman marriage love is implanted from creation, and together with it the love of procreating, which... from women is introduced into men.
Marriage love with women acts as one with their virginity...
A satan ascended with his woman...
On the punishments of women who lead a delicate and lazy life. SE 1746. AC 944.
See Chamber.
The female sex belongs to the classes of celestial things.
Under Cupidity, see this reference.
On a (bad) woman.
A common idea which greatly attracts the eyes is that of women...
Under Siren, see this reference. SE 4594.
When they perceive that paradisiacal things exist in the other life, girls and women are more allured to the Knowledges of faith than in any other way...
They represented... those who care nothing for natural... but only for spiritual things... by a beautiful naked woman...

(Females, who, having been lascivious girls, nauseate marriage; and if they contract it have no pleasure in it, marriage love being destroyed with them; they rarely have offspring, and if they do they do not love them, many of them being the most filthy prostitutes of all.)
The woman was not a Spirit, but was the representation of a woman.
He nauseated the whole female sex.
On a female Spirit who supposed herself to be completely in the body.
One beautiful appearance may arise from a number of lascivious women together.
They had as their Subject a filthy woman overhead.

(Sarah Hesselia) so inwardly hated her parents, that she had thought of poisoning them... She was afterwards so excited to hatred (against me), that she thought she would murder me if she could. She having died, before speech with Spirits was opened with me, I desired to kill myself with a knife... It is now disclosed that it was that woman... who excited the desire whenever I saw the knife... From this it may be evident that men may be infested by the dead, who, unknown to them, have hated them.
Women who have not paid attention to Knowledges of truth and good...
She was obsessed by diabolical women, who had subjugated their own husbands...
Women can enunciate with affection... but not teach. But such are rarely interiorly devout. Example(s).
Lasciviousness with women so appears there. The women treated them cruelly. SE 5467.
The hinder gulf was for women.
On women who preach... They lose the feminine nature... and become material...
Women who are obsessed act as if they were insane: this was seen in one woman...
In a separate chamber (in Hell) are those who had been women...
A woman becomes the affection of truth when she wills to marry.
Evil Spirits cannot endure the idea and consequent spiritual sphere of what is feminine...
Societies of the female sex.
Timid Spirits of the female sex.
A woman shall compass a man () = that a new Church will be established in which truth will be conjoined with its own affection... A woman = the Church as to the affection of truth.
Women = those who are in good from the affection of truth... Here, () women = those also who are in evils from the affection of falsity: because it is said that one shall be taken and the other left.
A woman not conjoined with a man () = the Church as to affection towards truth, or as to conjunction with truth.
The woman was created to be the affection of good...
As one man cannot be intimately united to two women.
The woman is born to be the affection of love. Thus a woman is born to be good... and a man to be truth. AE 1121. DWis 3. 3. 2.
See Adultery.
(On lascivious women, who appear as great mice.) DeConj 55.
On the Dutch women.
